about: Prediction files in predictions/<track>/<file>.jsonl and the named entries the scorer builds from them. An entry is a list of seeds; each seed is a per-photo weighted sum of predicted kcal of the listed files. With several seeds, MAE and the other metrics are the mean over seeds and intervals use the seed-mean absolute error per photo. Names follow the paper.

files.caloriek: CalorieK, PyTorch reference weights (Dralkh/CalorieK, revision 9049a8f95e55334bcbecbc0de82d04cb21668a39). Plate totals and macros.
files.boba: Boba, Q4_K_M GGUF with mmproj (Doses-AI/boba-0.8b-food-GGUF, revision 089010e0ec12d24044cb94f1d4597a10d8490790) on llama.cpp, temperature 0.1, app prompt and grammar.
files.qwen3.8-27b-zero-shot: Qwen3.8-27B zero-shot, AWQ INT4 on vLLM, app prompt and grammar through structured outputs, greedy decoding.
files.e2-q8_0: E2: Qwen3.5-0.8B food-list model, Q8_0 GGUF with mmproj on llama.cpp, temperature 0.1.
files.r1e: R1E: SigLIP2-base plate-total regressor (the registered run).
files.j5: J5: OneJev 0.8B decision model, kcal only.
files.e2-d-j5-list-t0.1: E2-D-J5 food list (Plum 1's list), Q8_0 GGUF on llama.cpp, temperature 0.1. Totals are the list sums.
files.e2-rl-list-t0.1: E2-RL food list (in the previous Plum candidate), Q8_0 GGUF on llama.cpp, temperature 0.1. Totals are the list sums.
files.g5-seed7: G5 seed 7: the Grape 1 recipe (banded decision head on a SigLIP2 encoder, point estimate is the distribution mean), seed 7.
files.g5-seed13: G5 seed 13: Grape 1. Research outputs from the training code (bicubic resize), not the app file.
